regs_in_letter: FD&C Act misbranding (false or misleading); no CFR section cited in letter text

cases.claim: “It’s my treatment, my way” with SUPER “VYVGART Hytrulo self-injection for treatment MY way” | “Vyvgart Hytrulo, for weekend-away Steve.” | “It’s travel ready, and can go where I go” with SUPER “VYVGART Hytrulo self-injection can go where I go.” | “Self-injection fits my plans” with SUPER “VYVGART Hytrulo A self-injection that can fit MY plans” (woman then tailgating at a stadium)
cases.context: IFU: 30 minutes at room temperature on clean flat surface, supplies, hand washing, sharps disposal; small SUPER 'Travel ready in its original carton...' does not mitigate.
cases.rationale: Oversimplifies administration as easy while traveling or at outdoor events.
cases.check: Do convenience/portability claims imply administration is simpler than the Instructions for Use require?

cases.claim: Major statement does not communicate: “Allergic reactions: …get emergency help right away if you have any of the following symptoms of an allergic reaction: rash, swelling of the face, lips, throat or tongue, shortness of breath, trouble breathing, low blood pressure, fainting” | “Infusion or injection-related reactions: …Tell your healthcare provider if you have any of the following symptoms...”
cases.rationale: Omits material W&P risk from the major statement.
cases.check: Rule: each W&P in the PPI 'possible side effects' section must be represented in the TV major statement.

cases.claim: Zooming into food on a grill, tailgating with friends, a woman looking at a robotic arm, a man taking a selfie on a mountain path during the major statement.
cases.check: Are visuals during the major statement engaging enough to compete with the risk audio?
